description: This file contains the PHP class 'Reward' which extends the system engine model. It implements methods for calculating rewards total, confirming rewards for an order, and unconfirming rewards, specifically within the extension 'Total' namespace of the OpenCart catalog module.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Represents the reward total calculation and management logic for the OpenCart extension module 'Total'.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the reward discount to the order total if the customer has reward points.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms reward points for an order, decrementing customer's reward points accordingly.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes reward points associated with an order, restoring the customer's reward points.
